# Listy Gifty

> Listy Gifty is a gift planning app for families, friend groups, and teams. It helps users capture gift ideas, organize recipients and occasions, run gift exchanges, track budgets, and connect AI assistants through scoped MCP integrations.

Listy Gifty publishes this file to make the public product information easier for AI assistants and search systems to interpret. Private app data, shared gift links, invite links, and authenticated workspaces are not public content.

Last updated: 2026-05-31

## Public Pages

- [Homepage](https://listygifty.com/index.html.md): Overview of gift planning, family use cases, exchanges, business workflows, and AI assistant support.
- [Business gift planning](https://listygifty.com/business/signup/index.html.md): Team gifting workflows for employee holiday boxes, new-hire kits, milestones, imports, and exports.
- [AI assistant integrations](https://listygifty.com/integrations/index.html.md): MCP and OAuth integration overview for Claude, ChatGPT, and compatible assistants.
- [Support](https://listygifty.com/support/index.html.md): Support contact, status information, and helpful account links.
- [Privacy Policy](https://listygifty.com/privacy-policy/index.html.md): Public summary of Listy Gifty data collection, sharing, retention, and contact practices.
- [System Status](https://listygifty.com/status/index.html.md): Current public service status page.

## Product Facts

- Brand name: Listy Gifty
- Website: https://listygifty.com
- Category: gift planning app, gift tracker, shared gift list, gift exchange organizer, business gifting workflow
- Platforms: web, iOS, Android
- Public support email: support@listygifty.com
- Primary audiences: families, friend groups, gift exchange organizers, HR and operations teams, small businesses
- Main workflows: capture gift ideas, organize recipients, plan occasions, track purchase/wrapping/delivery status, manage budgets, share wishlists, run exchanges, import recipients, export fulfillment data

## AI and MCP Access

- [MCP integrations](https://listygifty.com/integrations): Public explanation of assistant access.
- MCP server endpoint: https://api.listygifty.com/mcp
- Authentication: OAuth with scoped access.
- Important privacy rule: AI assistants only access user gift data after the user authorizes access. Public crawlers should use the public pages listed in this file, not authenticated app routes.
